question: A cute, heart-melting episode with Crusch-san!
answer: After she turned fifteen, her father Meckart had promised she could drink (In the Kingdom of Lugunica, the drinking age is fifteen), and after she'd been given a bottle around the time she was nine years old, every year she'd been counting down "After four more years, father." "After three more years, father". When the promised year finally came, it was the best drink of Meckart's life.
